name: astro-plugins
description: Personal Claude Code plugins for solo hobby projects.

plugins.name: solo-review
plugins.description: Code review for a solo developer working with agents: fresh-context finders and a blind verifier review the change when you ask, fix what's Important and re-review the fix; ship opens a GitHub PR with the evidence and merges on your sign-off; explain and learn keep you and the reviewer improving.

plugins.name: web-reader
plugins.description: Read a web page or a whole site as its own complete text, not a model's summary: saves pages as Markdown with Python's standard library, and with headless Chromium, pages built by JavaScript and a picture of each chart, diagram and image.
